positions.name: InstrumentRecordCatalog
positions.frame: how does the record catalog restate the calibration claim as a structured field?
positions.why: Both segments render the instrument and its calibration as flat bulleted field-labels — matter-of-fact, informational restatement of src-1's claim rather than independent testimony. They cohere as a single catalog-style transcription of the same calibration fact, distinct in register and footing from the lead astronomer's original assertion.
